feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 11:21am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 11 October 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline later today as a complex area of low pressure in the Atlantic drives frontal troughs across the area overnight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling southeast 3 or 4 this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 this evening, then further increasing 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then spells of rain or drizzle spreading from the southwest tonight. Risk of mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist. Occasionally very poor in any fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 at first, imminently veering south or southwest, soon increasing 5 or 6, occasionally reaching force 7 in places overnight, then veering west or southwest Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate, occasionally rough in places overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, with areas of mist and fog patches. Rain overnight into Tuesday, becoming mainly fair Tuesday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor, but very poor in any fog patches.
